merchant/31420.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Tomanel: Hi, I'm Tomanel! I recently started to work here. Are you looking for a spellbook? I still don't know much about our collection... I was told that all the spellbooks we have here have been supervised by our Grand Magister himself!

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
